subtitle: Academic Reading 1
courseType:
English Language Program

educationalGoal: There are 3 course objectives 1. Be able to read and understand passages in the textbook at an appropriate speed. 2. Be able to understand, read, and pronounce the vocabulary in the textbook. 3. Be able to give a presentation on the topic taught in each unit.
advice: Reading is a core component of listening, speaking, and writing skills. The objective of this course is to improve all 4 skills through reading passages at an appropriate speed to understand the content. The following topics will be covered: Unit 5: Finding Wonders. Unit 6: Reef Encounters. Unit 7: Dollars and Scents. Unit 8: Great Explorers. Extra readings will be distributed in class. Active learning in English class includes presentations, Q&A sessions, pair-work, group work, and worksheets. Preview: Read the story, check the content, pronunciation, vocabulary, and answer all of the questions in the textbook. In class: Ask questions and solve any problems you have encountered during the preview. Review: Check the content and pronunciation of the words in the story and memorize the vocabulary. Use office hours to ask extra questions. Plan and prepare for group presentations. Make study plans throughout the semester.
requiredKnowledge: Students must have a basic knowledge of grammar and vocabulary. There will be daily quizzes.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the topic of the story in each unit.
Be able to understand the structure of paragraphs and stories.
Be able to read, listen, pronounce, and write the words in the story in each unit.
Be able to find specific information about each story using various reading skills at an appropriate speed.
Be able to understand the story and exchange opinions with other students.
Be able to give a presentation on the topic taught in each unit.
